full_prompt_en: A square Baroque oil painting presents a young woman seated at a table against a nearly black interior. She wears a rich green outer garment over a pale blouse, with a white cloth wrapped loosely around her dark curly hair. Her left elbow rests near the tabletop and her hand supports the side of her face as she looks sharply upward. Light from high on the left illuminates her forehead, cheek, throat, open collar and one folded sleeve. The rest of the room disappears into darkness, leaving only a narrow brown wall edge and the dim table surface visible. Her expression is attentive and searching, intensified by the long exposed line of her neck and the turn of her eyes. The green fabric is painted with broad, bright folds on the shoulder and darker passages near the forearm. Flesh tones are warm ivory and rose, modeled more smoothly than the rougher cloth and background. A small yellowish highlight near the lower right edge hints at something on the table but does not become a clear narrative object. The composition is compact and asymmetrical: luminous figure on the left, deep black field on the right. Strong contrast and directional light give the ordinary resting pose dramatic gravity. The brushwork feels physical, with crisp lit edges breaking quickly into velvety shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形巴洛克油画呈现一位年轻女子坐在桌边，背后是几乎发黑的室内。她穿浓绿色外衣，里面是浅色上衣，一块白布松松裹住深色卷发。左肘靠近桌面，手支着脸侧，目光猛然向上。左上高处来光照亮额头、脸颊、喉部、敞开的领口和一只折起的袖。房间其余部分消失在黑暗里，只能看到窄窄棕色墙边和暗桌面。神情专注而追寻，露出的长颈线与眼睛转向使之更强烈。绿布在肩部由宽阔明亮褶线绘成，到前臂附近落入更暗区域。肤色是暖象牙和玫瑰色，比粗糙衣料与背景塑造得更平滑。右下边缘一点黄色亮痕暗示桌上有物，却未形成明确叙事物件。构图紧凑且不对称：左侧明亮形体，右侧深黑色域。强对比与定向光给平常托腮姿势戏剧性重量。笔触有实体感，清脆受光边缘很快破入丝绒阴影。
style_prompt_en: The Baroque oil painting concentrates warm light on a compact set of curved planes within a nearly black field. Deep green, ivory and muted rose emerge from umber shadow. Upper directional illumination makes crisp highlights and quick transitions to velvety dark. Broad folds carry energetic brushwork; smoother blending is reserved for the brightest center. Asymmetrical spacing leaves substantial negative space on one side, heightening a focused, dramatic stillness.
style_prompt_zh: 这种巴洛克油画把暖光集中在近黑色域内一组紧凑弯曲平面上。深绿、象牙色和低饱和玫瑰色从赭棕阴影里出现。上方定向照明制造清脆亮边，并迅速过渡到丝绒般暗处。宽褶承载有力笔触，最亮中心才保留更平滑的融合。不对称留距让一侧拥有大面积空色域，强化聚焦而戏剧性的静止。
theme_en: A woman in green lifting her gaze from a dark room
theme_zh: 深暗房间里身着绿衣仰望的女子
name: Artemisia Gentileschi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
